notes.title: Quick update
notes.notes:
Hello!
This is a quick update to fix the errors found.
List of updates:
[list]
[*] Changed interface functionality. Now fast forward is removed to the right-bottom corner.
[*] Added a background for displaying Nick's notes for better text perception.
[*] Fixed scrolling bug in Nick's notes.
[*] The first chapter returned the missing dialogues.
[*] Fixed text clipping.
[*]Returned missing scenes.
[*]Fixed problems with saving in chapter 4
[/list]

notes.title: Atrocity Chapter 4 is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
The fourth chapter of Atrocity is now available in Steam.
We also fixed a few found bugs and errors in the translation.

notes.title: Developer diaries: Artworks
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
Despite the holidays, our team is working to give you a new chapter. We really want to publish it as soon as possible. And now let's get acquainted with a new character and find out what awaits us in the new chapter?

So let's welcome Nick. Who is this mysterious friend of Andrew? And what does he know about what happened to Roman?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34040595/ec238050dae48be50b5b0977b73fb1dec35c1270.jpg[/img]


In this chapter, you will learn what kind of power lives in Necropolis and how it relates to Promgen.

notes.title: Atrocity is now available!
notes.notes:
Atrocity is finally released on Steam!
The first three chapters are fully accessible to play. Two more are already preparing for publication, you can see them in the coming weeks.
We plan to release each of the next chapters within one or two following weeks.
All new chapters are automatically downloadable content that will be added to every game owner's account.

We hope you enjoy our game. And your feedback will help us make our future games better!
